rationale.automation-bias: Professionals report over-trust, shallow acceptance, compulsive reliance, and deskilling.
rationale.quality-debt: Participants observe bloated, brittle, opaque, and increasingly unmaintainable generated code.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Accelerated generation creates substantial debugging, validation, and review pressure.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Participants test functionality, business logic, responsiveness, usability, and production readiness.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Manual debugging, testing, review, and readiness decisions form explicit checkpoints.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Visible uncertainty and code explanations help practitioners calibrate trust.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents forget intent, add unsolicited components, and enter correction loops.
rationale.org-governance: Enterprise policies govern tool access, sensitive data, accountability, and sign-offs.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Participants demand persistent action histories, prompt records, attribution, and edit trails.
